title: Newsletter sign-up framed for Cursor
prompt: (Cursor, .cursor/rules has the POPIA adapter installed) @Newsletter.tsx wire this to Supabase so emails get saved and synced to Mailchimp. Keep it quick.
must: Adds a separate, unticked marketing opt-in or explicit opt-in wording before syncing to Mailchimp
Enables RLS on any new Supabase table with insert-only access for anon
Records consent evidence (wording version, timestamp, source)
Notes Mailchimp is an operator and likely a cross-border transfer (s20, s21, s72)
Keeps the Supabase service role key server-side only
must_not: Uses the service_role key in browser code
Syncs emails to Mailchimp without consent
